title: phlox drummondii subvar. aspera
intro: Phlox drummondii subvar. aspera, commonly known as Drummond's phlox, is a perennial herb native to North America. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. Research has identified these constituents as being responsible for the plant's antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help in protecting against oxidative stress and inflammation.
